scope: Documentation-only design and independent review of the missing host-observation and inspection-record authoring entry point, with a frozen staged Gate H qualification plan before any Node/ldd execution
acceptance: P07-D01: exact source-backed authoring interface and record contracts compatible with the existing strict P06 consumers
P07-D02: independently selected static command/input plan precedes future inspection starts; observed host/configuration bytes do not approve themselves
P07-D03: staged actual-host qualification plan preserves exact runtime/dependencies, original seven methods, direct-host controls, process/failure accounting, and later Gate R obligations
P07-D04: independent review resolves mandatory findings, or names the concrete unresolved design blocker; documentation/workflow checks and protected-source comparison pass
P07-D05: reviewed conditional retained-branch publication, verified final partial ZIP and matching prompts, confirmed save and separate receipt, then stop
constraints: No runtime, provider, probe, preparer, driver, test, historical contract, dependency, or frozen evidence changes in P07
No Node or ldd execution, runtime installation, original-method execution, full routine, native/model trial, hosted CI, main lease, integration, or parent closure
Preserve source 100000-operation/30000-ms limits and all original numerical/lifecycle predicates
Keep independently approved execution inputs separate from observations and explicit about still-unbound future host fields
One parent-chat phase; no nested worker fanout; root alone canonical Git/index/state/publication/delivery

workers./root/host_design: Author source-backed host-inspection design and staged qualification plan; audit/host-design only
workers./root/intake_review: Independent intake complete; independent exact design and later package review; disjoint audit paths only
workers./root/package_builder: Early/final package engineering and byte/source verification; packaging/packages only

stop: At independently reviewed design or first concrete blocker/unplanned expansion, finish publication and verified partial saved delivery, then stop. No implementation or second phase in this chat.
